_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: hazard 0.15 a year unexposed, x 0.6 after the exposure starts

agreement.claim: both engines report the same log hazard ratio, standard error and interval
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: below 1e-9. harness/survival_examples.test.py maximizes the counting-process partial likelihood from scratch and checks the estimate and standard error against it. Times carry seven decimals so no event times tie; at four decimals two did, and a no-ties oracle is then not exact.

recovery.claim: the log hazard ratio for current exposure is close to the fixture's

calibration.limits: At 600 people the miss (0.39) nearly equalled the effect (0.51); the fixture uses 1500. The ever-exposed coding misses by 1.10, far outside the tolerance, and the control asserts it.
